title: AREA 47 Outdoor Adventure Park
highlights: Grösster Outdoor-Freizeitpark Österreichs auf 20.000 Quadratmetern am Eingang des Ötztals
Water AREA mit 20.000 Quadratmetern Badesee, Cannonball, Rutschenpark und Slip and Slide
Höchster Hochseilgarten Österreichs unter einer Brücke in 27 Metern Höhe
Umfassendes Guiding-Angebot für Wildwasser-Rafting, Canyoning und Wakeboarding
kurzbeschreibung: AREA 47 at the entrance of the Ötztal is Austria's largest outdoor adventure park, featuring the Water AREA, giant slides, wakeboarding, and rafting.
beschreibung:
The Ultimate Outdoor Playground of the Alps

Situated right on the 47th parallel, where the Ötztaler Ache meets the Inn, lies AREA 47. This spectacular adventure park combines thrilling outdoor sports, adrenaline rushes, and water fun amidst a breathtaking natural backdrop.

Water AREA and Extreme Sports Adventures

In the expansive Water AREA, daring ski jumps, water ramps, and high-speed freefall slides deliver pure excitement. For climbing enthusiasts, the high ropes course offers thrilling challenges at a dizzying height of 27 meters right beneath the Inntal bridge structure.
